citations.claim: initial state at rest, zero controller force
first violation: controller force exceeds fmax at step 1

counterfactual.change: Set controller noise from 0.20907593308629832 to 0.0; with clean sensing the commanded force stays within fmax so the violation disappears.

explanation: Velocity-error controller uses noise-corrupted sensor reading without clamping to fmax: seeded noise inflates the velocity error so kp*error exceeds fmax (144.7 > 111.3) on the very first step. Removing noise removes the excess command.
vision_note: The controlled red ball sits near the top-right corner while its green waypoint lies far away in the bottom-left, requiring a large corrective drive. Between step 0 and step 1 the ball barely moves, consistent with the force-limit breach occurring in the commanded force on the very first step.
